labels.rationale: Rich already supports rendering a Table without a header via show_header=False; this is a usage question.

body:
Rich already supports this through the `show_header` option on `Table`. Pass `show_header=False` to render a table with only its data rows. The option is described in the tables docs: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst

For questions about how to use Rich, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
